# NormGen - Normal pseudo-random generator
**author: Piotr Sulewski, Pomeranian University, Antoni Drapella, professor emeritus**

<!-- badges: start -->
<!-- badges: end -->


## Installation

You can install the released version of **PSDistr** from CRAN with:

``` r
install.packages("NormGen")
```

You can install the development version of **NormGen** from [GitHub](https://github.com/) with:

```r
library("remotes")
install_github("PiotrSule/NormGen")
```

### Function
  
**Rnorm**
  
Random generation for the Normal Distribution are calculated

```{r}
library(NormGen)
Rnorm(10,2,2)
```
